injuries.t: LeBron James OUT (low back/sciatica), downgraded from questionable. Embiid likely sits one game of back-to-back. Barlow, Fall, Hukporti out; Wade Q.
Saka, Saliba, Tzolis out
Grealish (ill), Branthwaite (concussion protocol) out
Pep Chavarria out; Malo Gusto returns
QB M. Heintschel listed out-for-season
vs Michigan State: MSU QBs Alessio Milivojevic and Cam Fancher out, true freshman Kayd Coffman to start; UCLA also starting backup QB Ty Dieffenbach. UCLA leg kept but recheck line before kickoff.
Koundé (ankle) and Dani Olmo (adductor) out for El Clásico; Eric García and Christensen also out.
Storm Austen (80mph winds) puts Man United vs Bournemouth and Liverpool vs Brighton at risk of postponement; recheck before betting.
Lamar Jackson OUT (high left ankle sprain), third straight game; Tyler Huntley starts vs Bengals. LB Tavius Robinson (IR) and S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) also out.
Curry out (rest, back-to-back), Podziemski out (back); Draymond Green doubtful.
Malkin out (illness); Girard to IR; Chinakhov out. Silovs starts.
Levi on IR; Jarry starts vs Toronto; Ekholm out 3 games.
Yves Missi out (knee).
Jalen Duren OUT (hamstring) Sunday at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle).
Paolo Banchero out 4-6 weeks (high ankle sprain).
Knueppel, Coby White, Boswell, Grant Williams out vs Heat (2nd of back-to-back).
DeVonta Smith, Nolan Smith, Wicks out Monday vs Cowboys; Barkley questionable.
S Jevon Holland (concussion) and TE Theo Johnson (neck) downgraded to OUT at Texans; Greg Newsome II out; Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
Bulls C Nic Claxton out (hamstring); Wizards rookie AJ Dybantsa out (ankle), third straight game.
Cameron Johnson, Spencer Jones, Strawther out; Alpha Diallo questionable vs Pelicans.

vs Suns: Curry (knee management), Draymond Green (back), Podziemski (back), Horford (back) out; Butler, Moody, Porzingis also out. Suns: Ighodaro out. Supports Suns -6.5 leg; line likely already adjusted.
C Jalen Duren OUT (right hamstring) at 76ers; Ausar Thompson questionable (ankle). Paul Reed expected to start.
Zach Edey OUT (ankle management, back-to-back) at Kings; Cedric Coward questionable (wrist).
S Jevon Holland, TE Theo Johnson, CB Greg Newsome II out at Texans; LB Tremaine Edmunds to IR.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and WR Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out Monday vs Cowboys.
Courtois (flu) out for El Clásico; Lunin starts in goal. Vinícius Jr suspended.
WR Puka Nacua questionable (calf), will test pregame; Davante Adams out (hamstring); CB Trent McDuffie Q, LB Nate Landman out. Recheck Rams -8.5 before kickoff.
RB Breece Hall questionable/unlikely (quad) vs Dolphins; Braelon Allen expected to lead.
Lamar Jackson confirmed OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts.
Devin Carter - Out: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.
Egor Demin - Out: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.
Tyler Bilodeau - Out: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.
Dennis Schroder - Day-To-Day: Schroder (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Wizards.
Kon Knueppel - Out: Knueppel (hamstring) will practice with the G League's Greensboro Swarm on Thursday, the Hornets announced.

Coby White - Out: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.
Grant Williams - Out: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.
Kylan Boswell - Out: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.
Patrick Williams - Out: Williams (adductor) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
Jalen Smith - Day-To-Day: Smith is questionable for Friday's game against Boston with a left finger sprain.
Tobe Awaka - Day-To-Day: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game in Boston.
Nic Claxton - Out: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.
Tarik Biberovic - Out: Biberovic (heel) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game versus the Rockets.
Santi Aldama - Out: Aldama (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against Houston.
Sergio de Larrea - Out: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.
Naji Marshall - Day-To-Day: Marshall is questionable for Friday's game against the Rockets with an illness.
Dereck Lively II - Out: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.
Alpha Diallo - Out: Diallo (personal) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Suns.
Cameron Johnson - Out: Johnson (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against Phoenix.
Spencer Jones - Out: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.
Julian Strawther - Out: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.
Isaiah Joe - Day-To-Day: Joe (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Brooklyn.
Jalen Duren - Out: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Gui Santos - Day-To-Day: Santos (knee) is listed as doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors.

Kristaps Porzingis - Out: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Moses Moody - Out: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Jimmy Butler III - Out: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
Reed Sheppard - Out: Sheppard (back) is out for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
Marcus Smart - Out: Smart (forearm) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
Alperen Sengun - Day-To-Day: Sengun (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Mavericks.
Steven Adams - Out: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.
Andrew Nembhard - Day-To-Day: Nembhard (neck) is listed as probable for Friday's game against Miami.
Aaron Nesmith - Day-To-Day: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Friday's game against the Heat.
Ivica Zubac - Out: Zubac (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.
T.J. McConnell - Out: Pacers head coach Rick Carlisle stated McConnell (hamstring) is "doing better" and "getting closer" to a return, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.
Ben Sheppard - Out: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
Tyrese Haliburton - Out: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Johnny Furphy - Out: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.
Rui Hachimura - Day-To-Day: Hachimura (quadriceps) is questionable for Friday's game against Minnesota, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports.
Yanic Konan Niederhauser - Out: Niederhauser (foot) had his third-year team option picked up Thursday by the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Max Strus - Out: Strus (foot) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Brandon Ingram - Out: Ingram (Achilles) is making progress but is set to miss at least one more week, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
Bradley Beal - Out: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
Jordan Miller - Out: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.
Cameron Carr - Out: Carr (oblique) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Golden State.
Adou Thiero - Out: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.
Ziaire Williams - Day-To-Day: Williams (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against Golden State.
Simone Fontecchio - Day-To-Day: Fontecchio (illness) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Indiana.
Anthony Edwards - Out: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
Donte DiVincenzo - Out: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.
Jose Alvarado - Out: Alvarado (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Philadelphia.
Jonathan Isaac - Out: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game in Toronto.
Jalen Suggs - Out: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Paolo Banchero - Out: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Noah Penda - Out: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson - Out: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.
Jabari Walker - Out: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game versus New York.
Jaylen Brown - Day-To-Day: Brown (knee) is questionable for Friday's game against the Knicks.
Tacko Fall - Out: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.
Dominick Barlow - Out: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
Ariel Hukporti - Out: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.
Oso Ighodaro - Day-To-Day: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
Mark Williams - Out: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Kawhi Leonard - Out: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.
Nate Bittle - Out: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.
Tre Johnson - Day-To-Day: Johnson (Achilles) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Charlotte.
Justin Champagnie - Out: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.
Tristan Vukcevic - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
Jamir Watkins - Out: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
Brennan Othmann - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Devin Cooley - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Jonathan Huberdeau - Injured Reserve: Huberdeau (hip) skated with his teammates Saturday, but he isn't close to returning, Pat Steinberg of QR Calgary 770 AM reports.
Samuel Honzek - Injured Reserve: ir
Brad Marchand - Injured Reserve: Marchand (leg) has started skating and is tentatively three weeks away from returning, per George Richards.
Aleksander Barkov - Injured Reserve: Barkov (lower body) resumed skating Wednesday, George Richards of Florida Hockey Now reports.
Jacob Markstrom - Injured Reserve: ir
Jonah Gadjovich - Injured Reserve: Gadjovich (upper body) is out indefinitely, the team announced Thursday.
Seamus Casey - Injured Reserve: Casey will be out of action for 6-8 weeks after undergoing a knee procedure, Kristy Flannery of The Hockey News reports Friday.
Jared McCann - Injured Reserve: McCann (lower body) will be out for approximately 10 weeks, the team announced Sunday.

Jacob Melanson - Injured Reserve: Melanson's upper-body injury was diagnosed Saturday as an anterior mediastinum hematoma with vascular pseudo aneurysm. He will continue to be evaluated and is out indefinitely.
Ryan Lindgren - Injured Reserve: Lindgren (upper body) was placed on injured reserve by the Kraken on Thursday and is expected to miss four to six weeks.
Jake O'Brien - Injured Reserve: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on non-roster injured reserve Wednesday.
Carter Hart - Day-To-Day: day-to-day
Parker Wotherspoon - Injured Reserve: ir
Vladislav Namestnikov - Injured Reserve: ir

Nick Bjugstad - Injured Reserve: Bjugstad (pectoral), Dawson Mercer, Nico Daws, Alexander Command and a pair of draft picks were traded to the Jets from the Devils on Friday in exchange for Connor Hellebuyck.
Josh Morrissey - Injured Reserve: Morrissey (wrist) was placed on injured reserve Monday.
Garrett Brown - Injured Reserve: ir-nr

conditions.name: v2 higher avg CLV vs FanDuel
v2 higher avg CLV vs Pinnacle
At least 30 top picks graded (each model)

model_check.rule: v1 is live. v2 is only PROPOSED (switch_ready) when ALL hold on the same graded legs: 100+ graded legs, lower log loss, higher avg CLV vs FanDuel AND vs Pinnacle, 30+ top picks graded and a top-pick win rate (King's Favorite/Best Parlay legs + top leg per game) at least v1's. Even then the user is asked first; it never switches on its own.

sharp_filter.note: Report only: tested live on 2026-10-25, it swapped 16 of 36 game picks and lowered the average Pinnacle-rated win chance of the picks (86.7% -> 85.9%), because the safest alt lines carry the most FanDuel vig. Since the goal is win rate, it stays off.
sharp_filter.rule: Legs dropped when FanDuel's price implies a chance more than 3 pts above Pinnacle's no-vig fair chance (you'd be overpaying vs the sharp market).

favorite_rule: Green = King's Favorites: the Best Parlay, plus the 3 ladder parlays (2+ legs) with the highest expected value among those with a raw (un-boosted) estimated hit chance of 50% or more.
